description: Known Dask and cuDF NULL limits from the NULL-semantics work. (1) On Dask a mixed ascending and descending sort keeps NULLs last for every key (its optimizer drops helper flag columns), so Q34 and Q71 order NULLs differently from the reference there. (2) On Dask, results kept lazy (for example Q98, which has no LIMIT) report a NULL key as NaN, because _none_for_null returns a lazy frame unchanged; per-partition conversion would give mixed dtypes (raised in review of #2541). (3) The cuDF family may need dtype care for numeric NULL handling. For each: support it with a test, or document it where users read about backend differences.
